strategy.summary: Shoot either upper saucer four times to reach 5x. Clear the two drop banks and center 8 ball to collect all 15 pool balls. Shoot an upper saucer for the 75,000 maximum bonus, reset the rack, and repeat.

quickInfo.name: Bonus X
quickInfo.summary: Each upper-saucer shot advances the multiplier to a 5x maximum.

quickInfo.name: Linked rack
quickInfo.summary: The default setting drops the same-height target in the opposite bank after one direct hit.

quickInfo.name: Pool-ball bonus
quickInfo.summary: Each collected ball adds 1,000 to base bonus for a 15,000 full rack.

quickInfo.name: Collect Bonus
quickInfo.summary: A full rack at 5x scores 75,000 at either upper saucer and resets all targets.

steps.text: If Extra Ball or Special has tournament value, plunge the center B lane; otherwise, use the safest top feed.
Watch the first ball leave the top and identify the safe nudge or catch before you repeat a saucer.
Shoot either upper saucer until 5x is lit.
modeNotes: Bonus X: Each saucer scores 5,000 and advances the multiplier; 5x is the maximum.

steps.text: Hit one controlled drop target and watch the opposite bank to learn the paired-target setting.
modeNotes: Paired rack: The default setting drops the same-height target in the opposite bank, so one safe shot can collect two pool balls.

steps.text: Use the safer target in each same-height pair to clear the 14 drop targets.
Hit the center captive ball hard enough to trip its rollover and collect the 8 ball.
modeNotes: Pool-ball bonus: Each of the 15 collected balls adds 1,000 to base bonus.

steps.text: After all 15 balls are lit, shoot either upper saucer to collect the full bonus and reset the rack.
modeNotes: Collect Bonus: A full rack scores 15,000 times Bonus X, for a 75,000 maximum at 5x.

steps.text: Repeat the 5x rack-and-collect cycle. Do not shoot the captive ball after the 8 ball is already collected.

fallback.title: Recovery: Partial rack and 5x bonus
fallback.when: Recovery pivot: Use this when the captive ball or several targets reject dangerously.

steps.text: Build 5x at the upper saucers.
Use the safer target in each same-height pair to collect pool balls.
Do not force the center 8 ball only to complete the rack.
Protect the partial base bonus at 5x.
Expect the partial rack to reset at the drain.

alternatives.title: Position play: A-B-C awards
alternatives.when: When trailing, use this higher-ceiling route: use this only when Extra Ball or Special has tournament value.

steps.text: Plunge the center B lane.
Collect A at the left inlane and C at the right inlane.
Hit the center 8 ball to collect the lit Extra Ball.
After the Extra Ball collect, shoot an upper saucer for Special.
Stop when the awards give no useful points.
Reach 5x at the upper saucers.
Collect all 15 pool balls.
Shoot an upper saucer for the 75,000 maximum Collect Bonus.
Repeat after the targets reset.

techniques.name: B-lane plunge
techniques.instruction: Time the plunge for the center B lane when A-B-C awards have tournament value.

techniques.name: Linked-target selection
techniques.instruction: If the opposite same-height target also drops, aim at the safer member of each pair.

cautions.issue: Drop-target rebounds can strike the sides of the center 8-ball column.
cautions.response: Keep both flippers ready after every target hit.

cautions.issue: The center captive ball is a difficult rebound shot.
cautions.response: Do not repeat it after the 8 ball is collected and prepare to save the rebound.

cautions.issue: Balls leaving the top can create the largest uncontrolled feeds.
cautions.response: Watch one full exit before you repeat a saucer.

strategy.simpleOverview: Pinball Pool is a rack-and-collect game. Shoot either upper saucer four times to reach 5x, clear the two drop banks and center 8 ball, then shoot an upper saucer for the full 75,000 bonus and repeat after the rack resets.
strategy.overview: Four visits to either upper saucer raise Bonus X to 5x in Pinball Pool. The two banks and center captive ball represent the 15-ball rack; hitting one bank target also drops its same-height partner in the opposite bank. Clear each pair from its safer side, collect the 8 ball, then shoot either upper saucer for the maximum bonus.
